root_cause.text: The error path in `inotify_new_watch()` fails to call `dec_inotify_watches()` to undo the earlier `inc_inotify_watches()` when `fsnotify_add_inode_mark_locked()` fails, causing an inotify watch count leak (quota leak) that can exhaust `max_user_watches`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch explicitly adds `dec_inotify_watches(group->inotify_data.ucounts);` in the error branch after `inotify_remove_from_idr()`. The commit message states: "the error path calls inotify_remove_from_idr() but does not call dec_inotify_watches() to undo the preceding inc_inotify_watches(). This leaks a watch count". Also notes that before commit 1cce1eea0aff the increment was after successful insertion, so this path was not affected.
